sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values our long-standing partnership deeply. While our internal cost structures remain confidential, we are pleased to support our long-standing partnership by agreeing to your requested 24-month contract term. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

We appreciate your intention to commit the full annual volume; please provide the exact volume figures so we can accurately assess this commitment. Which volume can you commit to?

In exchange for this extended commitment, we propose a payment term of 45 days and a revised price of €52.30 per unit. Our full offer stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.10 per unit, under a price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
